entry.title: OsTirusMPC 1.0.0
entry.summary: First public release of OsTirusMPC by Pryonix, based on OsTIrus / Gearmulator by The Usual Suspects and DSP56300. ### Download - **OsTirusMPC-1.0-MPC-ARM64.zip**: ready-to-copy plugin, guides and licences. - **OsTirusMPC-1.0-Source.zip**: complete editable wrapper, engine source/dependencies, skins, licences and test sources. - **OsTirusMPC-1.0-SHA256SUMS.txt**: checksums for both archives. ### Installation MPC standalone ARM64, MPC OS 3.10.1 or later.
